crew_telegram_approval_allowed: What a Telegram approval request is edited to say after the owner tapped Allow (a check mark is put before it in code).
crew_telegram_approval_denied: What a Telegram approval request is edited to say after the owner tapped Deny (a cross mark is put before it in code).
crew_telegram_approval_prompt: Telegram approval request (Markdown): a crewmate asks to run a tool; {tool} is the tool's id and {input} its JSON input, shown in a code block under the Allow / Deny buttons.
crew_telegram_button_allow: Inline button under a Telegram approval request: let the crewmate run the tool.
crew_telegram_button_deny: Inline button under a Telegram approval request: do not let the crewmate run the tool.
crew_telegram_button_override: Inline button under the Telegram message of a refused task: accept the work despite the guards (the same as the card in the apps).
crew_telegram_button_retry: Inline button under the Telegram message of a refused task: run the task again with the guards' reasons added to its prompt.
crew_telegram_card_needs_you: Telegram message when a crewmate's finished task is parked on a card (the guards refused it, or a UI task has no captures): {reasons} is the guards' bullet list, one '- reason' per line, untranslated.
crew_telegram_crewmate_not_found: Telegram reply when /task names a crewmate the server does not have.
crew_telegram_error_unknown: What {error} of a failed task reads in the Telegram failure message when the task kept no error text.
crew_telegram_link_code_invalid: Telegram reply to /start with a wrong or expired link code.
crew_telegram_link_code_missing: Telegram reply to a bare /start: how to link the chat. /start is the command the user types.
crew_telegram_linked: Telegram reply when a /start code linked this chat to the computer running hostd; {hostname} is that computer's name.
crew_telegram_no_crewmates: Telegram reply to /crew when the server has no crewmates.
crew_telegram_not_queued: Telegram reply when the task's attachments were refused; {reason} is the cause, untranslated.
crew_telegram_photo_fetch_failed: Telegram reply when the photo of a task could not be downloaded from Telegram; {reason} is the technical cause, untranslated.
crew_telegram_prompt_too_long: Telegram reply when a task's prompt is longer than the limit; {max} is the limit.
crew_telegram_refusal_gone: Telegram: what the card message becomes when its button is tapped after the task was already answered or ended.
crew_telegram_refusal_overridden: Telegram: what the card message becomes after the owner tapped Override.
crew_telegram_refusal_retrying: Telegram: what the card message becomes after the owner tapped Retry with reasons.
crew_telegram_task_done: Telegram message to the crew owner when a crewmate's task ends well: the crewmate's name, then what the engine answered ({result}, the engine's own text, never translated).
crew_telegram_task_error: Telegram reply when hostd could not save the task; {error} is the technical cause, untranslated.
crew_telegram_task_failed: Telegram message to the crew owner when a crewmate's task fails: the crewmate's name and why ({error}, the engine's own text, never translated).
crew_telegram_task_queued: Telegram reply when a task was created and is in the crewmate's queue; {id} is the task id.
crew_telegram_task_usage: Telegram reply to /task without a prompt. /task is the command the user types.
crew_telegram_ui_usage: Telegram reply to a bare /ui with no message: how to use it. The command names (/ui, /task) are what the user types and stay as they are.
crew_telegram_which_crewmate: Telegram reply to plain text when the server has several crewmates and none was named.
crew_telegram_which_crewmate_photo: Telegram reply to a photo when the server has several crewmates and the caption names none.
